### JFrog and Industry Judges Recognize Global Brands Bringing Trust to the Software Supply Chain in the AI Era


October 27, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/528621000/files/doc_news/JFrog-and-Industry-Judges-Recognize-Global-Brands-Bringing-Trust-to-the-Software-Supply-Chain-in-the-AI-Era-2026.pdf)


*Inaugural Software Supply Chain Excellence Awards recognize Ford, NVIDIA, S&P Global, Rakuten Symphony, Singapore Airlines, TSB Bank, and more for revolutionizing software security, governance, and compliance at scale*


SUNNYVALE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[JFrog, Ltd.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fjfrog.com%2F%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dswampup2026%26utm_campaign%3Dcustomerwinners%26utm_content%3Dpr&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=JFrog%2C+Ltd.&index=1&md5=2f316763b9671e76d056d7dfb0300844) (Nasdaq: FROG), the Liquid Software company and creators of the[JFrog Software Supply Chain Platform](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fjfrog.com%2Fplatform%2F%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dswampup2026%26utm_campaign%3Dcustomerwinners%26utm_content%3Dpr&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=JFrog+Software+Supply+Chain+Platform&index=2&md5=ce57456c6b3eb892ffa4fc9a929e5d17) , the system of record for trusted software artifacts, binaries, and AI assets, today announced the global winners of its inaugural[Software Supply Chain Excellence Awards](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fjfrog.com%2Fsoftware-supply-chain-awards%2F%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dswampup2026%26utm_campaign%3Dcustomerwinners%26utm_content%3Dpr&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=Software+Supply+Chain+Excellence+Awards&index=3&md5=b8e42af39651426206b1bc3b3cc9cc98) . The nine honorees span the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, across three categories: Unified Platform, Trusted AI Adoption, and Software Supply Chain Security.


JFrog's inaugural Software Supply Chain Excellence Awards recognize Ford, NVIDIA, S&P Global, Rakuten Symphony, Singapore Airlines, TSB Bank, and more for revolutionizing software security, governance, and compliance at scale


“Agents now write, review and deploy code faster than ever, while malicious AI models, agent skills and extensions are turning up in the registries developers use daily. Increasing regulations require proof at every step – from code to runtime,” said Roie Shorer, Chief Growth Officer at JFrog. “The companies that pull ahead in the AI era will be those going beyond simply automating for speed and scale. The ones who can see exactly what’s shipping and why, will bring trust, control and adaptability. This year’s winners didn’t just add tools; they established a single source of truth where developers, security, and compliance teams can operate using the same data and the same rules. We’re very proud of all of them and thrilled to be part of their journey.”


The Software Supply Chain Excellence Awards recognize JFrog customers that innovated fearlessly to turn their software supply chain into a competitive advantage. A cross-functional panel of industry leaders and experts judged each entry based on two measures: strength of vision and the quality of metrics.


**The Convergence Award: One Team, One Platform**


The Convergence Award recognizes teams that remove silos – transitioning from fragmented solutions to a single, governed platform shared by both developers and security teams. AI is rapidly multiplying the tools, artifacts, and agents companies utilize, making cross-enterprise visibility, speed, and control challenging for human-dependent processes. The winners of this award overcame that challenge by standardizing on a single system of record – creating a shared workflow for building, securing and shipping software.


**Winners:**


- [Ford Motor Company](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ford.com&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=Ford+Motor+Company&index=4&md5=2a38903b81f0c4b2c177d0a7681e7937)
- [Rakuten Symphony](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fsymphony.rakuten.com%2F&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=Rakuten+Symphony&index=5&md5=d1ab5dd6cb78ac8bf6d6ccf721b2a54a)
- [SCHOTTEL Industries](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.schottel-industries.de%2Fen%2F&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=SCHOTTEL+Industries&index=6&md5=6e8fbe547ddfa31361425d209bbc5767)


**The Guardian Award: Software Supply Chain Security**


Software supply chains are under new strain as development teams grapple with AI-era threats. In the last year, JFrog identified[over 900 malicious AI agent skills carrying high-impact payload](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fjfrog.com%2Fsoftware-supply-chain-state-of-union%2F%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dswampup2026%26utm_campaign%3Dcustomerwinners%26utm_content%3Dpr&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=over+900+malicious+AI+agent+skills+carrying+high-impact+payload&index=7&md5=8e85443f78fce8b2f80426cfdb77a709)[s](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fjfrog.com%2Fsoftware-supply-chain-state-of-union%2F&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=s&index=8&md5=5e7441a5f4df957ffd16049a8ae867b9) . This year’s Guardian Award winners combatted these emerging threats by architecting a single source of truth that secures software artifacts from end to end. The Guardian Award honors teams who built supply chains that effectively stop threats at the point of entry vs. remediating them later.


**Winners:**


- [S&P Global](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.spglobal.com%2Fen&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=S%26P+Global&index=9&md5=78ba6090bcca9c2acb7035b0566f6e80)
- [Iress](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.iress.com%2F&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=Iress&index=10&md5=35c51c12c3528e8ba6cdbeaea606c67a)
- [TSB Bank](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tsb.co.uk%2F&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=TSB+Bank&index=11&md5=040123299f6411657d586f6c0b7c8db7)


**The Trusted Intelligence Award: Trusted AI Adoption**


AI assets are now part of the software supply chain, and governance must keep pace with adoption, or it risks becoming the bottleneck. The Trusted Intelligence Award recognizes teams that passionately embraced AI and made it work to their advantage without increasing their risk by extending governance and security to AI models, agent skills, and MCP servers.


**Winners:**


- [NVIDIA](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nvidia.com%2Fen-us%2F&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=NVIDIA&index=12&md5=ff76db36e75da664dabc0b684e884030)
- [Singapore Airlines](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.singaporeair.com%2Fen_UK%2Fgb%2Fhome%2F&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=Singapore+Airlines&index=13&md5=adf5c4704ee180993b61918d6f67b6bb)
- [Husqvarna Group](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.husqvarnagroup.com%2Fen&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=Husqvarna+Group&index=14&md5=c003e79dd8cf5edc6662a98f5478c025)


Winners of the first annual JFrog Software Supply Chain Excellence Awards were recognized during gala dinners hosted at JFrog’s annual customer, partner, and user conference –[swampUP](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fswampup.jfrog.com%2Fall-events%2F%3Futm_source%3Dbusinesswire%26utm_medium%3Dswampup2026%26utm_campaign%3Dcustomerwinners%26utm_content%3Dpr&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=swampUP&index=15&md5=6fe62e1e91cd4da595712b14f9797629) – which took place in both NYC and Barcelona throughout September and October. Further details on each winner’s implementation can be found at:[https://jfrog.com/software-supply-chain-awards/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fjfrog.com%2Fsoftware-supply-chain-awards%2F&esheet=54629346&newsitemid=20261027858636&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fjfrog.com%2Fsoftware-supply-chain-awards%2F&index=16&md5=c6ca415ff664334d1887a78261fb7d5c) .

**About JFrog**


JFrog Ltd. (Nasdaq: FROG), the creators of the unified DevOps, DevSecOps, DevGovOps and MLOps platform, is on a mission to create a world of software delivered without friction from development to production. Driven by a “Liquid Software” vision, the JFrog Platform is a software supply chain system of record that is designed to power organizations as they build, manage, and distribute secure software with speed and scale. Holistic security features help identify, protect, and remediate against threats and vulnerabilities. The universal, hybrid, multi-cloud JFrog Platform is available as both SaaS services across major cloud service providers and self-hosted. Millions of users and approximately 6,600 organizations worldwide, including a majority of the Fortune 100, depend on JFrog solutions to securely embrace digital transformation in the AI era.
